title: John Ternus says the Mac is "first and foremost" a device "built around the trackpad and keyboard", but sometimes "it's comfortable and handy to have touch" (Steven Levy/Wired)
summary: Steven Levy / Wired: John Ternus says the Mac is “first and foremost” a device “built around the trackpad and keyboard”, but sometimes “it's comfortable and handy to have touch” — An exclusive early look at Apple's new touchscreen MacBook Pro—the computer Apple said would never happen.
contentText:
Steven Levy / Wired :

John Ternus says the Mac is “first and foremost” a device “built around the trackpad and keyboard”, but sometimes “it's comfortable and handy to have touch”   —  An exclusive early look at Apple's new touchscreen MacBook Pro—the computer Apple said would never happen.
